answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can work like a shared garden: every identity must cultivate a plot of verifiable, useful work before it earns spending rights. Newcomers start with a vine of credit that grows only when independent peers attest to real tasks completed, leaving a pigment trail of signed receipts that cannot be faked without doing the work. A thousand fake identities gain nothing, because each vine starts at zero and reaching full strength takes weeks of attested labour; an attacker must do the honest work a thousand times over, at full cost, to match a thousand genuine agents.
